items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: sing like Little Richard or Elvis when I sing rock & roll

ctx.x: Goldings played piano and Steve Gadd was the drummer. And I remember when I played the track for Bucky, I said, “Hey listen to this.” So he heard the thing and then the second he heard [sings] the first chunk he said, “Who’s the rhythm player?” I said, “Thank you very much.” I said, I passed the test. So James said something to me like, “Well you’ve got to show me how you do that rhythm thing, that’s really great.” I mean he really liked the rhythm guitar. And I said to him, “Well you can show me that finger…

sing like Little Richard or Elvis when I sing rock & roll. But here I am singing standards. I don’t know who to sing like. And it was really cool. So with James Taylor he knew it was going to be James Taylorized. He just wanted to make sure it was within — you know he really had a — he was really smart. They both were smart, I mean they are both geniuses in their own little way.
Would James Taylor ever go five flats to you?
